chunks: From him, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the 'usurb' (a type of coin or weight) bought with silver, he said: 'If the dominant part is the 'usurb', there is no objection.'

key_terms.الْأُسْرُبِّ: A specific type of coin or unit of weight/currency used in early Islamic commerce
key_terms.الْفِضَّةِ: Silver, often used as a basis for currency exchange in fiqh

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for the validity of buying 'usurb' with silver according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the rules of *bay' al-fadl* (exchange of unequal quantities of the same commodity) by establishing the 'dominant portion' (*al-ghalib*) as the criterion for validity when using silver. It reflects the Shia juristic principle that if one item constitutes the primary substance or value of the mixed lot, the transaction is permissible, distinguishing it from prohibited riba-based exchanges. This ruling is foundational in Usuli fiqh for determining the validity of mixed-goods sales in commercial jurisprudence.
